sentences.hanzi: 教师节快到了，小明和丽丽想给老师做一个特别的礼物。 他们决定一起做一张手工卡片。 丽丽在卡片上画了很多漂亮的花，小明在旁边写字。 小明用他最好的字写：“老师，谢谢您。” 他写了一次又一次，因为想写得更好。 丽丽问：“你觉得这张卡片怎么样？” 小明说：“我觉得很好，老师一定会喜欢的。” 丽丽说：“我觉得老师看到一定会很感动。” 小明说：“我也这么觉得，老师每天教我们，真的很辛苦。” 卡片做好以后，他们去花园摘了一些新鲜的花。 花园里的花有红色的，有黄色的，还有白色的，都很漂亮。 到了学校，他们把花和卡片一起送给了老师。 老师看到卡片上的字和那些新鲜的花，感动地说：“谢谢你们，这是我收到的最好的礼物。” 老师接着说：“其实，你们努力学习、对别人好，就是给我最好的礼物。” 小明和丽丽听了老师的话，都很开心。 从那天起，他们学习更努力了，对同学也更好了。 他们知道，努力学习就是对老师最好的感谢。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié kuài dào le, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì xiǎng gěi lǎoshī zuò yīgè tèbié de lǐwù. Tāmen juédìng yīqǐ zuò yī zhāng shǒugōng kǎpiàn. Lìlì zài kǎpiàn shàng huàle hěn duō piàoliang de huā, Xiǎomíng zài pángbiān xiě zì. Xiǎomíng yòng tā zuì hǎo de zì xiě: "Lǎoshī, xièxie nín." Tā xiěle yī cì yòu yī cì, yīnwèi xiǎng xiě de gèng hǎo. Lìlì wèn: "Nǐ juéde zhè zhāng kǎpiàn zěnmeyàng?" Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ juéde hěn hǎo, lǎoshī yīdìng huì xǐhuan de." Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ juéde lǎoshī kàndào yīdìng huì hěn gǎndòng." Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ yě zhème juéde, lǎoshī měitiān jiāo wǒmen, zhēn de hěn xīnkǔ." Kǎpiàn zuò hǎo yǐhòu, tāmen qù huāyuán zhāile yīxiē xīnxiān de huā. Huāyuán lǐ de huā yǒu hóngsè de, yǒu huángsè de, hái yǒu báisè de, dōu hěn piàoliang. Dào le xuéxiào, tāmen bǎ huā hé kǎpiàn yīqǐ sòng gěi le lǎoshī. Lǎoshī kàndào kǎpiàn shàng de zì hé nàxiē xīnxiān de huā, gǎndòng de shuō: "Xièxie nǐmen, zhè shì wǒ shōudào de zuì hǎo de lǐwù." Lǎoshī jiēzhe shuō: "Qíshí, nǐmen nǔlì xuéxí, duì biérén hǎo, jiùshì gěi wǒ zuì hǎo de lǐwù." Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì tīngle lǎoshī de huà, dōu hěn kāixīn. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, tāmen xuéxí gèng nǔlì le, duì tóngxué yě gèng hǎo le. Tāmen zhīdào, nǔlì xuéxí jiùshì duì lǎoshī zuì hǎo de gǎnxiè.
sentences.english: Teacher's Day was coming, and Xiaoming and Lili wanted to make a special gift for their teacher. They decided to make a handmade card together. Lili drew many beautiful flowers on the card, and Xiaoming wrote words beside them. Xiaoming wrote, using his very best handwriting: "Teacher, thank you." He wrote it again and again, because he wanted to write it better. Lili asked: "What do you think of this card?" Xiaoming said: "I think it's very good. The teacher will surely like it." Lili said: "I think the teacher will be very touched to see it." Xiaoming said: "I think so too. The teacher teaches us every day, and it's really hard work." After the card was finished, they went to the garden and picked some fresh flowers. The flowers in the garden were red, yellow, and white, all of them very beautiful. When they got to school, they gave the flowers and the card to the teacher. Seeing the words on the card and those fresh flowers, the teacher said, deeply moved: "Thank you both. This is the best gift I have ever received." The teacher went on: "In fact, working hard at your studies and being kind to others is the best gift you can give me." Xiaoming and Lili were very happy to hear the teacher's words. From that day on, they studied even harder and treated their classmates even better. They knew that studying hard was the best way to thank their teacher.
